% tcolorbox titles that hold fragile commands: \implies redefined with
% \@ifstar, \kind with \@ifstar, and \pick with \@ifnextchar, with
% hyperref. (Without hyperref or nameref, the PDF fails on them too: a
% fragile command breaks in tcolorbox's \protected@edef of the name.)
% A numbered theorem, labelled or not, with the label= option, a
% short title (the second optional argument, and the short title key), in
% italics and sans-serif, from \DeclareTcbTheorem and \renewtcbtheorem, and
% a box with nameref=, each set the title as the name that a \nameref
% gives. The unnumbered theorem, the plain titles, the theorem= key on a
% plain box, and a \footnote in a title do not, and built before.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\implies{\@ifstar{\ensuremath{\Longrightarrow}}{\ensuremath{\Rightarrow}}}
\newcommand\kind{\@ifstar{starred}{plain}}
\newcommand\pick{\@ifnextchar[{\pick@given}{x}}
\def\pick@given[#1]{#1}
\makeatother
\newtcbtheorem[number within=section]{theorem}{Theorem}{}{thm}
\DeclareTcbTheorem{remark}{Remark}{}{rem}
% (environments to renew, without the counter that \newtcbtheorem would make)
\newenvironment{claim}{}{}
\newenvironment{claim*}{}{}
\renewtcbtheorem{claim}{Claim}{colback=white}{cl}
\newtcolorbox[auto counter]{named}[2][]{nameref={#2}, title={Box \thetcbcounter: #2}, #1}
\newcounter{exercise}
\begin{document}
\section{Theorems}
\begin{theorem}{Differentiable \implies\ continuous}{dc}Labelled.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}{Unlabelled $p\implies q$ \kind}{}Unlabelled.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}{Starred $p\implies* q$ \kind*}{star}Starred forms.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[label=byoption]{Option \kind}{}Labelled by the option.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[][Short $p\implies q$ \kind]{Long title}{short}With a short title.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[short title={Key \pick[y]}]{Keyed title}{key}With the short title key.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}{Pick \pick[y] or \pick}{pick}An optional argument.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}{Styled \textit{\kind*} and \textsf{\pick[s]}}{}In italics and sans-serif.\end{theorem}
\begin{remark}{Declared \kind*}{}From DeclareTcbTheorem.\end{remark}
\begin{claim}{Renewed \pick[r]}{}From renewtcbtheorem.\end{claim}
\begin{theorem*}{Unnumbered \kind* $p\implies q$}{}Unnumbered.\end{theorem*}
\begin{tcolorbox}[title={Plain $a\implies b$ \kind*}]A plain title.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[title={Also plain $a\implies* b$ \pick[z]}]Another.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[theorem={Exercise}{exercise}{Keyed \kind}{ex}]The theorem key.\end{tcolorbox}
\begin{tcolorbox}[title={Noted\footnote{A \kind\ note.}}]A footnote in the title.\end{tcolorbox}
\section{Named boxes}
\begin{named}{Named $p\implies q$ \kind}A box with nameref.\end{named}
\begin{named}[label=named]{Labelled \pick[n]}A labelled box with nameref.\end{named}

See Theorem~\ref{thm:dc}, \ref{thm:star}, \ref{byoption}, \ref{thm:short},
\ref{thm:key}, \ref{thm:pick}, Exercise~\ref{ex}, and Box~\ref{named}.

Named: \nameref{thm:dc}; \nameref{thm:star}; \nameref{byoption};
\nameref{thm:short}; \nameref{thm:key}; \nameref{thm:pick}; \nameref{named}.
\end{document}
